head: 00bb3056dca6eb08be810b22af581d5e3538e694
claim: A captain-asked ticket cannot be closed, cancelled or deleted without the captain's quoted words or an answered confirm card, and the words are recorded

target.version: juggernaut bin/jg-tasks-axi.sh and bin/jg-captain-ask-lib.sh at this commit

steps.start: a disposable juggernaut home with a real backlog
steps: try to cancel and close a captain-asked ticket with no words, a blank quote and an unanswered card
close one with a quote and one with an answered confirm card
steps.result: the captain-asked ticket stays until his words or an answered card are given, and the words are recorded; an ordinary ticket is unaffected

verdicts.seen: I read all 9 result blocks and the 2-line record. The gate refuses close, cancel and delete without a quote or an answered card (no words, blank quote, unanswered card-2, self-answer, card-1 naming another ticket). It allows the quoted and answered-card closes, and the record logs the quote and the card. The outcome is shown.
